authority: Sa-plan SQLite owns task states, workers, attempts and dependencies; this manifest is a versioned acceptance projection, not a scheduler

recovery_target: One reconciled SQLite authority; historical stores preserved as evidence; no automatic history rehash-to-admission

requirements.execution: All executable work, fan-out jobs and workflows have canonical Sa-plan identity; no direct task SQL or shadow queues
requirements.interface: Pure typed intent decision and separate fenced interpreter; schemas for inputs, outputs, refusals, effects and observations
requirements.coordination: Actual incarnation identity, hierarchy, scope, heartbeat, durable inbox/ACK, exclusive ownership and evidence
requirements.feature_tracker: Canonical DB feature registry linking all services/capabilities to MCP mappings, coverage obligations and source-bound observations; inventory completeness independently reconciled
requirements.mcp_availability: Listed is not usable; success requires current actual client invocation plus response schema, authorization/refusal and evidence checks

law_obligations: Deny dominance and no amplification of caller authority
Idempotent same-intent replay and conflicting replay refusal
Receipt and schema preservation across interpreters
No promotion of UNKNOWN STALE MOCK EXCLUDED or NOT_ADMITTED to availability
Pure reference interpreter agrees with bounded optimized interpreter
